prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one standalone professional image for an Arabic family visual guessing game (age 16+).
Subject: an empty soccer stadium with green pitch and clear white field lines.
Style: realistic high quality photography with correct anatomy and object geometry, clean natural textures.
Composition: landscape 4:3, the complete subject fills about 75% of the frame; centered with ample margins, immediately recognizable when revealed.  Spread meaningful details across the frame because it will be shuffled into twelve tiles.
Background: simple uncluttered setting appropriate to the subject, natural lighting.
Constraints: exactly the stated subject; no label, caption, watermark, collage, borders or readable words.

review.scope: Source image identity/anatomy/framing and actual12-tile jumble/reveal/hide gameplay for this specific question.
review.note: Football stadium shows grass pitch, goals, center circle and stands; intended as an object-identification illustration, not a regulation field diagram.
